sentences.text: ii. Any other relief which this Hon'ble Court deems fit in the facts and circumstances of the case may also kindly be granted.

It is submitted by Counsel for the petitioner that compensation in lieu of land acquired under National Highways Act, 1956 awarded to the petitioners since was inadequate an objection had been submitted before learned Civil Court under Section 34 of Arbitration and Conciliation Act which had been registered as Case No. 26 of 2017 and same is pending before Second Additional District Judge, Gwalior for more than six years, therefore, if directions are issued to the learned Second, Additional District Judge, Gwalior to decide the aforesaid objections within a time bound manner, the grievance of the petitioner would be redressed.
P er contra, learned Counsel for respondent has no objection if such directions are issued.

Looking to the innocuous prayer made by the counsel for the petitioner, the petition is disposed of with a direction to learned Second Additional District Judge, Gwalior to decide pending Case No. 26 of 2017, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of six months from the date of receipt of certified copy of the order.
With the aforesaid, the petition stands disposed of.
E- copy/Certified copy as per rules and directions.
